thread:
maria_csm: Hey folks — quick thread for AuroraTek day0 private deploy. Networking layer is green but they hit two blockers: cross-account KMS for audit logs and outbound egress to their Splunk endpoint. If we don't clear both by EOW they flagged renewal concerns. @ben_se @carla_net please advise.

ben_se: Thanks Maria. Can you paste the exact error they're seeing for KMS? Is it key policy denial or STS AssumeRole failure?

carla_net: It's a key policy denial. Their security team insists the CMK must live in their logging account and only allow their account principals. Our logshipper (running in their VPC) can't encrypt with a key we create. They also have a managed firewall that blocks outbound on non-standard ports — Splunk endpoint requires 443 with SNI, but the proxy does TLS inspection which breaks certs.

kevin_sre: Two quick options: 1) we guide them to create the CMK in their account and add our service principal (a short-lived role) to the key policy, or 2) use envelope encryption where we hold the data key but the CMK is theirs. Policy example for granting a role access:

```
{
  "Sid": "AllowRedwoodRoleUse",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/redwood-logging-role"},
  "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```

kevin_sre: For egress: confirm outbound CIDR + FQDN for Splunk, we can provide a short-lived IP allow list and a TCP healthcheck script to validate.

maria_csm: Their security wants no long-term external principals in key policy. They said they can approve a short-term role ARN but need an audit trail for who used the key. Also asked for walkthrough doc for on-call in case of failures.

sophia_pm: I can own the enablement doc + one-pager for audit trail steps. Suggest a 30m handoff call with their security and our SRE + NetOps tomorrow. What times work?

ben_se: I can join at 10:00am PT. I'll bring the sample AssumeRole ARN and a demo script to rotate data keys.

carla_net: For firewall: ask them to allow egress to 34.210.45.0/24 (our logshipper pool) and outbound 443 to logs.prod.splunk.example.com. Quick curl test they can run from a bastion:

```
curl -v --resolve logs.prod.splunk.example.com:443:34.210.45.12 https://logs.prod.splunk.example.com/health
```

carla_net: If TLS inspection is mandatory, we recommend cert pass-through or allowlist the IP without inspection for that FQDN.

deploy-bot: Ticket CS-3421 created for 'AuroraTek KMS & egress' and assigned to ben_se, carla_net, kevin_sre :white_check_mark:

maria_csm: Action items: (1) ben to share Role ARN + demo script (2) carla to send firewall allowlist + curl test (3) sophia to draft enablement + audit runbook (4) kevin to propose envelope-encryption fallback. Target: patch by EOD Friday. I'll follow up in morning standup. Thanks :thumbsup: 

ben_se: Sharing demo script and temporary ARN in thread shortly.

carla_net: Will DM the network changelog template to AuroraTek and link the curl test results here.

kevin_sre: I'll draft fallback steps and include CloudTrail query examples for auditors.

maria_csm: Updated risk: medium -> will escalate if no progress by Thursday COB. Ping me if any blocker.

sophia_pm: Scheduling call for tomorrow 10am PT and inviting AuroraTek security.
